description: Circlet of Faith Level 60 Father Inigo Montoy at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make a Circlet of Faith if you bring him the following: 1 Desecrated Circlet, 15 Wartorn Cloth Scraps, 3 Mooncloth and 3 Nexus Crystals. Requirements: - Desecrated Circlet - Wartorn Cloth Scrap x 15 - Mooncloth x 3 - Nexus Crystal x 3
name: Circlet of Faith
